description: Central Provincial  Council -  Amend the Minute of the Central Provincial Public  Management Assistants Service
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the service minute for the Central Provincial Public Management Assistant's Service, specifically addressing educational qualifications, examination requirements, and training courses for public service officers.
